name: Eden Network
rootCause: The ownership of the MEV infrastructure Eden Network deployer address was hacked and took control of the EDEN token contract. The attacker claims that a new token contract will be deployed, and Eden Network can redeem ownership after purchasing 200 ETH of NEDEN.
